terra.chapter1.subtitle: Alone
terra.chapter1.cutscene.area_intro4: I must get back to the warmth of the Nether
terra.chapter1.cutscene.area_outro1: You drift off to sleep in your new shelter~
terra.chapter1.cutscene.area_outro2: What do we have here? The so-called strider hanging out with our sworn enemy, the Piglins?
terra.chapter1.cutscene.area_outro3: Boss, you know what must be done!
terra.chapter1.cutscene.area_outro4: Indeed, when the time is right, we will teach the strider a lesson they will never forget!
terra.chapter1.cutscene.area_outro7: Time to continue onwards into the caves.
terra.chapter1.cutscene.nether_bully_sce: Flashbacks start to fill your mind~
What kind of strider is that?!
What a shock, they can't even walk three steps without falling into the lava!
What a massive collider, if you know what I mean!
Haha, good one! Hey Strider outsider, get out of our pool. If you can't be a provider, then you don't belong here, fool.
terra.chapter1.info1: You can toggle between seeing yourself or not by hitting F5.
terra.chapter1.info2: Using the shift key (sneak) while above water or lava activates the striding ability. The striding ability allows you to walk on water or lava until you run out of stamina. Note: Once the ability is active, you will automatically move forward, and you won't be able to turn.
terra.chapter1.info3: Lava doesn't hurt you. However, it still often hurts enemies. It also gives you a regeneration effect.
terra.chapter1.info4: You can use your pickaxe to break spawners.
terra.chapter1.info5: In this map, you don't need to time weapon swings. Click as fast as you want!
terra.chapter1.info6: You can use your pickaxe to mine gilded blackstone for gold.
terra.chapter1.info7: Water is freezing cold and very dangerous.
terra.chapter1.piglin1: I'm afraid you can't stay here, friend. It's late so you should head back to your home soon.
terra.chapter2.subtitle: Home
terra.chapter2.cutscene.escape_nether1: Quickly, we must flee like a breeze through the portal!
terra.chapter2.cutscene.escape_nether2: I will take you to my village. The chief will listen to me and allow you a place to live among us. Just stay close.
terra.chapter2.cutscene.escape_nether3: A beast from the Nether with Snowfeather? Keep an eye on that one, Rocky.
terra.chapter2.cutscene.area_outro1: They are finally back. We were so worried! Wait, where is Snowfeather at?
terra.chapter2.cutscene.area_outro2: What if the strider did something to Snowfeather?!
terra.chapter2.cutscene.area_outro3: Little one never do such thing. They have heart of iron. I watched. I observed. Kind one.
terra.chapter2.cutscene.area_outro4: It is true that a lot of villagers have been vanishing lately...
terra.chapter2.cutscene.area_outro5: But what can we do? This storm isn't going to go away any time soon.
terra.chapter2.cutscene.area_outro6: What are you kids doing?! That is dangerous!
terra.chapter2.cutscene.area_outro7: Just keep at it, and you will improve in no time!
terra.chapter2.cutscene.area_outro8: We are running low on resources, and we need you two to go out and search for some supplies.
terra.chapter2.cutscene.area_outro9: Stay safe out there. I sense a storm is coming.
terra.chapter2.cutscene.area_outro10: As always, we got this. We will be back before you know it.
terra.chapter2.cutscene.area_outro11: Even if time is against us, we can't go out until the storm passes.
terra.chapter2.cutscene.boss_intro2: You don't have your villager friend with you to save you this time!
terra.chapter2.encounter.wither_skeleton: Boss, I'll take over for now!
terra.chapter2.info1: Striding on water/lava can get you into one block tall locations.
terra.chapter3.subtitle: Hero
terra.chapter3.cutscene.boss_intro1: With this sacrifice, I shall open up a portal to the Spirit Dimension!
terra.chapter3.cutscene.boss_intro2: Wait, who goes there?! You would foolishly dare interfere with our work?
terra.chapter3.cutscene.boss_intro3: I suppose I wouldn't mind adding another ice sculpture to my collection.
